entities.name: Fall of Sarinth
entities.description: Fall of the city of Sarinth in late 43 AR after many years of siege by Ashnod.

entities.name: Sarinth
entities.description: City besieged for years for its oil and lumber; its people were pacified and sent as soldiers.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Sent by Mishra to obtain Sarinth's resources; laid siege to the city.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Ordered Ashnod to stay and ended up relocating from his fortress to Tomakul.

entities.name: Liberation of Yotia
entities.description: Enabled when Mishra had to release pressure elsewhere.

entities.name: Tomakul
entities.description: City to which Mishra relocated from his fortress.

events.summary: Ashnod, sent by Mishra for Sarinth's oil and lumber, is refused and is ordered to stay, forcing a siege.
events.quote: Ashnod had been sent by Mishra to obtain the city's oil and lumber resources, but was refused.

events.summary: The siege diverts Fallaji forces, enabling the Liberation of Yotia and forcing Mishra to relocate to Tomakul.
events.quote: enabling the Liberation of Yotia and forcing Mishra to relocate from his fortress to Tomakul

events.summary: In late 43 AR Sarinth finally falls, its people pacified and resources plundered.
events.quote: It was late 43 AR when the city finally fell.

relations.quote: Ashnod had been sent by Mishra
